title: The GEX Problem: You Don't Know What's in the Books
text: People think that if you get this tagged index level data that you now can reconstruct the market maker book and thus derive what they may or may not do. It's completely wrong because you have no idea what else is in that dealer book and you have to remember you cannot look at things like GEX in a vacuum. You can't say GEX in SPX is blank so if price gets to whatever level in SPX the dealers will do blank because you have no idea what else the dealers are holding. Their entire position might be the exact inverse of what you expect.
